description: This file defines functions for sending email via SMTP and a stub for sending WhatsApp messages, intended as integrations within a FastAPI project.

methods.name: None send_email_reminder(recipient_email: str, subject: str, message: str)
methods.description: Sends an email reminder through SMTP using environment-configured SMTP settings. Raises HTTPException if configuration is incomplete or sending fails.

methods.name: None send_whatsapp_reminder(recipient_phone: str, message: str)
methods.description: A stub function intended for sending WhatsApp messages via third-party API; currently raises NotImplementedError.

ctags.name: send_email_reminder
ctags.pattern: /^def send_email_reminder(recipient_email: str, subject: str, message: str) -> None:$/
